name: NIST SP 800-53
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description: U.S. federal catalog of security and privacy controls for information systems and organizations, organized into 20 control families. The control baselines that select from it are published separately as profiles.

controls.label: Policy and Procedures
controls.description:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] access control policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the access control policy and the associated access controls;
b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the access control policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current access control:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.label: Account Management
Automated System Account Management
controls.description: Support the management of system accounts using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.label: Automated Temporary and Emergency Account Management
controls.description: Automatically [Selection: remove; disable] temporary and emergency accounts after [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.label: Disable Accounts
Automated Audit Actions
controls.description: Automatically audit account creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal actions.

controls.label: Inactivity Logout
controls.description: Require that users log out when [Assignment: organization-defined time period of expected inactivity or description of when to log out].

controls.label: Dynamic Privilege Management
controls.description: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined dynamic privilege management capabilities].

controls.label: Privileged User Accounts
Dynamic Account Management
controls.description: Create, activate, manage, and deactivate [Assignment: organization-defined system accounts] dynamically.

controls.label: Restrictions on Use of Shared and Group Accounts
controls.description: Only permit the use of shared and group accounts that meet [Assignment: organization-defined conditions].

controls.label: Shared and Group Account Credential Change
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-2k.

controls.label: Usage Conditions
controls.description: Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances and/or usage conditions] for [Assignment: organization-defined system accounts].

controls.label: Account Monitoring for Atypical Usage
controls.description:
(a) Monitor system accounts for [Assignment: organization-defined atypical usage]; and
(b) Report atypical usage of system accounts to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.label: Disable Accounts for High-risk Individuals
controls.description: Disable accounts of individuals within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of discovery of [Assignment: organization-defined significant risks].

controls.label: Access Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

controls.label: Restricted Access to Privileged Functions
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-6.

controls.label: Dual Authorization
controls.description: Enforce dual authorization for [Assignment: organization-defined privileged commands and/or other actions].

controls.label: Mandatory Access Control
Discretionary Access Control
Security-relevant Information
controls.description: Prevent access to [Assignment: organization-defined security-relevant information] except during secure, non-operable system states.

controls.label: Protection of User and System Information
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into MP-4, SC-28.

controls.label: Role-based Access Control
controls.description: Enforce a role-based access control policy over defined subjects and objects and control access based upon [Assignment: organization-defined roles and users authorized to assume such roles].

controls.label: Revocation of Access Authorizations
controls.description: Enforce the revocation of access authorizations resulting from changes to the security attributes of subjects and objects based on [Assignment: organization-defined rules].

controls.label: Controlled Release
controls.description:
Release information outside of the system only if:
(a) The receiving [Assignment: organization-defined system or system component] provides [Assignment: organization-defined controls]; and
(b) [Assignment: organization-defined controls] are used to validate the appropriateness of the information designated for release.

controls.label: Audited Override of Access Control Mechanisms
controls.description: Employ an audited override of automated access control mechanisms under [Assignment: organization-defined conditions] by [Assignment: organization-defined roles].

controls.label: Restrict Access to Specific Information Types
controls.description: Restrict access to data repositories containing [Assignment: organization-defined information types].

controls.label: Assert and Enforce Application Access
Attribute-based Access Control
controls.description: Enforce attribute-based access control policy over defined subjects and objects and control access based upon [Assignment: organization-defined attributes].

controls.label: Individual Access
controls.description: Provide [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms] to enable individuals to have access to the following elements of their personally identifiable information: [Assignment: organization-defined elements].

controls.label: Discretionary and Mandatory Access Control
controls.description:
(a) Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined mandatory access control policy] over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy; and
(b) Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined discretionary access control policy] over the set of covered subjects and objects specified in the policy.

controls.label: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems based on [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control policies].

controls.label: Object Security and Privacy Attributes
controls.description: Use [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] associated with [Assignment: organization-defined information, source, and destination objects] to enforce [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control policies] as a basis for flow control decisions.

controls.label: Processing Domains
controls.description: Use protected processing domains to enforce [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control policies] as a basis for flow control decisions.

controls.label: Dynamic Information Flow Control
controls.description: Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control policies].

controls.label: Flow Control of Encrypted Information
controls.description: Prevent encrypted information from bypassing [Assignment: organization-defined information flow control mechanisms] by [Selection (one or more): decrypting the information; blocking the flow of the encrypted information; terminating communications sessions attempting to pass encrypted information; {{ insert: param, ac-04.04_odp.03 }} ].

controls.label: Embedded Data Types
controls.description: Enforce [Assignment: organization-defined limitations] on embedding data types within other data types.

controls.label: Metadata
controls.description: Enforce information flow control based on [Assignment: organization-defined metadata].

controls.label: One-way Flow Mechanisms
controls.description: Enforce one-way information flows through hardware-based flow control mechanisms.

controls.label: Security and Privacy Policy Filters
controls.description:
(a) Enforce information flow control using [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] as a basis for flow control decisions for [Assignment: organization-defined information flows]; and
(b) [Selection (one or more): block; strip; modify; quarantine] data after a filter processing failure in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy].

controls.label: Human Reviews
controls.description: Enforce the use of human reviews for [Assignment: organization-defined information flows] under the following conditions: [Assignment: organization-defined conditions].

controls.label: Enable and Disable Security or Privacy Policy Filters
controls.description: Provide the capability for privileged administrators to enable and disable [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] under the following conditions: [Assignment: organization-defined conditions].

controls.label: Configuration of Security or Privacy Policy Filters
controls.description: Provide the capability for privileged administrators to configure [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] to support different security or privacy policies.

controls.label: Data Type Identifiers
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, use [Assignment: organization-defined data type identifiers] to validate data essential for information flow decisions.

controls.label: Decomposition into Policy-relevant Subcomponents
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, decompose information into [Assignment: organization-defined policy-relevant subcomponents] for submission to policy enforcement mechanisms.

controls.label: Security or Privacy Policy Filter Constraints
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, implement [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] requiring fully enumerated formats that restrict data structure and content.

controls.label: Detection of Unsanctioned Information
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, examine the information for the presence of [Assignment: organization-defined unsanctioned information] and prohibit the transfer of such information in accordance with the [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy].

controls.label: Information Transfers on Interconnected Systems
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-4.

controls.label: Domain Authentication
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate source and destination points by [Selection (one or more): organization, system, application, service, individual] for information transfer.

controls.label: Security Attribute Binding
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-16.

controls.label: Validation of Metadata
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, implement [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy policy filters] on metadata.

controls.label: Approved Solutions
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined solutions in approved configurations] to control the flow of [Assignment: organization-defined information] across security domains.

controls.label: Physical or Logical Separation of Information Flows
controls.description: Separate information flows logically or physically using [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms and/or techniques] to accomplish [Assignment: organization-defined required separations].

controls.label: Access Only
controls.description: Provide access from a single device to computing platforms, applications, or data residing in multiple different security domains, while preventing information flow between the different security domains.

controls.label: Modify Non-releasable Information
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, modify non-releasable information by implementing [Assignment: organization-defined modification action].

controls.label: Internal Normalized Format
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, parse incoming data into an internal normalized format and regenerate the data to be consistent with its intended specification.

controls.label: Data Sanitization
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, sanitize data to minimize [Selection (one or more): delivery of malicious content, command and control of malicious code, malicious code augmentation, and steganography-encoded data; spillage of sensitive information] in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined policy].

controls.label: Audit Filtering Actions
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, record and audit content filtering actions and results for the information being filtered.

controls.label: Redundant/Independent Filtering Mechanisms
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, implement content filtering solutions that provide redundant and independent filtering mechanisms for each data type.

controls.label: Linear Filter Pipelines
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, implement a linear content filter pipeline that is enforced with discretionary and mandatory access controls.

controls.label: Filter Orchestration Engines
controls.description:
When transferring information between different security domains, employ content filter orchestration engines to ensure that:
(a) Content filtering mechanisms successfully complete execution without errors; and
(b) Content filtering actions occur in the correct order and comply with [Assignment: organization-defined policy].

controls.label: Filter Mechanisms Using Multiple Processes
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, implement content filtering mechanisms using multiple processes.

controls.label: Failed Content Transfer Prevention
controls.description: When transferring information between different security domains, prevent the transfer of failed content to the receiving domain.

controls.label: Process Requirements for Information Transfer
Separation of Duties
controls.description:
a. Identify and document [Assignment: organization-defined duties of individuals]; and
b. Define system access authorizations to support separation of duties.

controls.label: Least Privilege
controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users (or processes acting on behalf of users) that are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

controls.label: Authorize Access to Security Functions
controls.description:
Authorize access for [Assignment: organization-defined individuals and roles] to:
(a) [Assignment: organization-defined security functions (deployed in hardware, software, and firmware)]; and
(b) [Assignment: organization-defined security-relevant information].

controls.label: Non-privileged Access for Nonsecurity Functions
controls.description: Require that users of system accounts (or roles) with access to [Assignment: organization-defined security functions or security-relevant information] use non-privileged accounts or roles, when accessing nonsecurity functions.

controls.label: Network Access to Privileged Commands
controls.description: Authorize network access to [Assignment: organization-defined privileged commands] only for [Assignment: organization-defined compelling operational needs] and document the rationale for such access in the security plan for the system.

controls.label: Separate Processing Domains
controls.description: Provide separate processing domains to enable finer-grained allocation of user privileges.

controls.label: Privileged Accounts
controls.description: Restrict privileged accounts on the system to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.label: Privileged Access by Non-organizational Users
controls.description: Prohibit privileged access to the system by non-organizational users.

controls.label: Review of User Privileges
controls.description:
(a) Review [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] the privileges assigned to [Assignment: organization-defined roles and classes] to validate the need for such privileges; and
(b) Reassign or remove privileges, if necessary, to correctly reflect organizational mission and business needs.

controls.label: Privilege Levels for Code Execution
controls.description: Prevent the following software from executing at higher privilege levels than users executing the software: [Assignment: organization-defined software].

controls.label: Log Use of Privileged Functions
controls.description: Log the execution of privileged functions.

controls.label: Prohibit Non-privileged Users from Executing Privileged Functions
controls.description: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions.

controls.label: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.description:
a. Enforce a limit of [Assignment: organization-defined number] consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a [Assignment: organization-defined time period]; and
b. Automatically [Selection (one or more): lock the account or node for {{ insert: param, ac-07_odp.04 }}; lock the account or node until released by an administrator; delay next logon prompt per {{ insert: param, ac-07_odp.05 }}; notify system administrator; take other {{ insert: param, ac-07_odp.06 }} ] when the maximum number of unsuccessful attempts is exceeded.

controls.label: Automatic Account Lock
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-7.

controls.label: Purge or Wipe Mobile Device
controls.description: Purge or wipe information from [Assignment: organization-defined mobile devices] based on [Assignment: organization-defined purging or wiping requirements and techniques] after [Assignment: organization-defined number] consecutive, unsuccessful device logon attempts.

controls.label: Biometric Attempt Limiting
controls.description: Limit the number of unsuccessful biometric logon attempts to [Assignment: organization-defined number].

controls.label: Use of Alternate Authentication Factor
controls.description:
(a) Allow the use of [Assignment: organization-defined authentication factors] that are different from the primary authentication factors after the number of organization-defined consecutive invalid logon attempts have been exceeded; and
(b) Enforce a limit of [Assignment: organization-defined number] consecutive invalid logon attempts through use of the alternative factors by a user during a [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.label: System Use Notification
Previous Logon Notification
controls.description: Notify the user, upon successful logon to the system, of the date and time of the last logon.

controls.label: Unsuccessful Logons
controls.description: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the number of unsuccessful logon attempts since the last successful logon.

controls.label: Successful and Unsuccessful Logons
controls.description: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the number of [Selection: successful logons; unsuccessful logon attempts; both] during [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.label: Notification of Account Changes
controls.description: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of changes to [Assignment: organization-defined security-related characteristics or parameters] during [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.label: Additional Logon Information
controls.description: Notify the user, upon successful logon, of the following additional information: [Assignment: organization-defined additional information].

controls.label: Concurrent Session Control
controls.description: Limit the number of concurrent sessions for each [Assignment: organization-defined account and/or account types] to [Assignment: organization-defined number].

controls.label: Device Lock
controls.description:
a. Prevent further access to the system by [Selection (one or more): initiating a device lock after {{ insert: param, ac-11_odp.02 }} of inactivity; requiring the user to initiate a device lock before leaving the system unattended]; and
b. Retain the device lock until the user reestablishes access using established identification and authentication procedures.

controls.label: Pattern-hiding Displays
controls.description: Conceal, via the device lock, information previously visible on the display with a publicly viewable image.

controls.label: Session Termination
controls.description: Automatically terminate a user session after [Assignment: organization-defined conditions or trigger events].

controls.label: User-initiated Logouts
controls.description: Provide a logout capability for user-initiated communications sessions whenever authentication is used to gain access to [Assignment: organization-defined information resources].

controls.label: Termination Message
controls.description: Display an explicit logout message to users indicating the termination of authenticated communications sessions.

controls.label: Timeout Warning Message
controls.description: Display an explicit message to users indicating that the session will end in [Assignment: organization-defined time].

controls.label: Supervision and Review — Access Control
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-2, AU-6.

controls.label: Permitted Actions Without Identification or Authentication
controls.description:
a. Identify [Assignment: organization-defined user actions] that can be performed on the system without identification or authentication consistent with organizational mission and business functions; and
b. Document and provide supporting rationale in the security plan for the system, user actions not requiring identification or authentication.

controls.label: Necessary Uses
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-14.

controls.label: Automated Marking
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into MP-3.

controls.label: Security and Privacy Attributes
Dynamic Attribute Association
controls.description: Dynamically associate security and privacy attributes with [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects] in accordance with the following security and privacy policies as information is created and combined: [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy policies].

controls.label: Attribute Value Changes by Authorized Individuals
controls.description: Provide authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals) the capability to define or change the value of associated security and privacy attributes.

controls.label: Maintenance of Attribute Associations by System
controls.description: Maintain the association and integrity of [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] to [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects].

controls.label: Association of Attributes by Authorized Individuals
controls.description: Provide the capability to associate [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] with [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects] by authorized individuals (or processes acting on behalf of individuals).

controls.label: Attribute Displays on Objects to Be Output
controls.description: Display security and privacy attributes in human-readable form on each object that the system transmits to output devices to identify [Assignment: organization-defined instructions] using [Assignment: organization-defined naming conventions].

controls.label: Maintenance of Attribute Association
controls.description: Require personnel to associate and maintain the association of [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] with [Assignment: organization-defined subjects and objects] in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy policies].

controls.label: Consistent Attribute Interpretation
controls.description: Provide a consistent interpretation of security and privacy attributes transmitted between distributed system components.

controls.label: Association Techniques and Technologies
controls.description: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined techniques and technologies] in associating security and privacy attributes to information.

controls.label: Attribute Reassignment — Regrading Mechanisms
controls.description: Change security and privacy attributes associated with information only via regrading mechanisms validated using [Assignment: organization-defined techniques or procedures].

controls.label: Attribute Configuration by Authorized Individuals
controls.description: Provide authorized individuals the capability to define or change the type and value of security and privacy attributes available for association with subjects and objects.

controls.label: Remote Access
controls.description:
a. Establish and document usage restrictions, configuration/connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed; and
b. Authorize each type of remote access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

controls.label: Monitoring and Control
controls.description: Employ automated mechanisms to monitor and control remote access methods.

controls.label: Protection of Confidentiality and Integrity Using Encryption
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality and integrity of remote access sessions.

controls.label: Managed Access Control Points
controls.description: Route remote accesses through authorized and managed network access control points.

controls.label: Privileged Commands and Access
controls.description:
(a) Authorize the execution of privileged commands and access to security-relevant information via remote access only in a format that provides assessable evidence and for the following needs: [Assignment: organization-defined needs]; and
(b) Document the rationale for remote access in the security plan for the system.

controls.label: Monitoring for Unauthorized Connections
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SI-4.

controls.label: Protection of Mechanism Information
controls.description: Protect information about remote access mechanisms from unauthorized use and disclosure.

controls.label: Additional Protection for Security Function Access
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-3(10).

controls.label: Disable Nonsecure Network Protocols
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into CM-7.

controls.label: Disconnect or Disable Access
controls.description: Provide the capability to disconnect or disable remote access to the system within [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.label: Authenticate Remote Commands
controls.description: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms] to authenticate [Assignment: organization-defined remote commands].

controls.label: Wireless Access
controls.description:
a. Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of wireless access; and
b. Authorize each type of wireless access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

controls.label: Authentication and Encryption
controls.description: Protect wireless access to the system using authentication of [Selection (one or more): users; devices] and encryption.

controls.label: Monitoring Unauthorized Connections
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SI-4.

controls.label: Disable Wireless Networking
controls.description: Disable, when not intended for use, wireless networking capabilities embedded within system components prior to issuance and deployment.

controls.label: Restrict Configurations by Users
controls.description: Identify and explicitly authorize users allowed to independently configure wireless networking capabilities.

controls.label: Antennas and Transmission Power Levels
controls.description: Select radio antennas and calibrate transmission power levels to reduce the probability that signals from wireless access points can be received outside of organization-controlled boundaries.

controls.label: Access Control for Mobile Devices
controls.description:
a. Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for organization-controlled mobile devices, to include when such devices are outside of controlled areas; and
b. Authorize the connection of mobile devices to organizational systems.

controls.label: Use of Writable and Portable Storage Devices
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into MP-7.

controls.label: Use of Personally Owned Portable Storage Devices
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into MP-7.

controls.label: Use of Portable Storage Devices with No Identifiable Owner
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into MP-7.

controls.label: Restrictions for Classified Information
controls.description:
(a) Prohibit the use of unclassified mobile devices in facilities containing systems processing, storing, or transmitting classified information unless specifically permitted by the authorizing official; and
(b) Enforce the following restrictions on individuals permitted by the authorizing official to use unclassified mobile devices in facilities containing systems processing, storing, or transmitting classified information:
  (1) Connection of unclassified mobile devices to classified systems is prohibited;
  (2) Connection of unclassified mobile devices to unclassified systems requires approval from the authorizing official;
  (3) Use of internal or external modems or wireless interfaces within the unclassified mobile devices is prohibited; and
  (4) Unclassified mobile devices and the information stored on those devices are subject to random reviews and inspections by [Assignment: organization-defined security officials], and if classified information is found, the incident handling policy is followed.
(c) Restrict the connection of classified mobile devices to classified systems in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined security policies].

controls.label: Full Device or Container-based Encryption
controls.description: Employ [Selection: full-device encryption; container-based encryption] to protect the confidentiality and integrity of information on [Assignment: organization-defined mobile devices].

controls.label: Use of External Systems
controls.description:
a. [Selection (one or more): establish {{ insert: param, ac-20_odp.02 }}; identify {{ insert: param, ac-20_odp.03 }} ], consistent with the trust relationships established with other organizations owning, operating, and/or maintaining external systems, allowing authorized individuals to:
  1. Access the system from external systems; and
  2. Process, store, or transmit organization-controlled information using external systems; or
b. Prohibit the use of [Assignment: organization-defined prohibited types of external systems].

controls.label: Limits on Authorized Use
controls.description:
Permit authorized individuals to use an external system to access the system or to process, store, or transmit organization-controlled information only after:
(a) Verification of the implementation of controls on the external system as specified in the organization’s security and privacy policies and security and privacy plans; or
(b) Retention of approved system connection or processing agreements with the organizational entity hosting the external system.

controls.label: Portable Storage Devices — Restricted Use
controls.description: Restrict the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices by authorized individuals on external systems using [Assignment: organization-defined restrictions].

controls.label: Non-organizationally Owned Systems — Restricted Use
controls.description: Restrict the use of non-organizationally owned systems or system components to process, store, or transmit organizational information using [Assignment: organization-defined restrictions].

controls.label: Network Accessible Storage Devices — Prohibited Use
controls.description: Prohibit the use of [Assignment: organization-defined network-accessible storage devices] in external systems.

controls.label: Portable Storage Devices — Prohibited Use
controls.description: Prohibit the use of organization-controlled portable storage devices by authorized individuals on external systems.

controls.label: Information Sharing
controls.description:
a. Enable authorized users to determine whether access authorizations assigned to a sharing partner match the information’s access and use restrictions for [Assignment: organization-defined information-sharing circumstances]; and
b. Employ [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms] to assist users in making information sharing and collaboration decisions.

controls.label: Automated Decision Support
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms] to enforce information-sharing decisions by authorized users based on access authorizations of sharing partners and access restrictions on information to be shared.

controls.label: Information Search and Retrieval
controls.description: Implement information search and retrieval services that enforce [Assignment: organization-defined information-sharing restrictions].

controls.label: Publicly Accessible Content
Data Mining Protection
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined techniques] for [Assignment: organization-defined data storage objects] to detect and protect against unauthorized data mining.

controls.label: Access Control Decisions
controls.description: [Selection (one or more): establish procedures; implement mechanisms] to ensure [Assignment: organization-defined access control decisions] are applied to each access request prior to access enforcement.

controls.label: Transmit Access Authorization Information
controls.description: Transmit [Assignment: organization-defined access authorization information] using [Assignment: organization-defined controls] to [Assignment: organization-defined systems] that enforce access control decisions.

controls.label: No User or Process Identity
controls.description: Enforce access control decisions based on [Assignment: organization-defined security or privacy attributes] that do not include the identity of the user or process acting on behalf of the user.

controls.label: Reference Monitor
controls.description: Implement a reference monitor for [Assignment: organization-defined access control policies] that is tamperproof, always invoked, and small enough to be subject to analysis and testing, the completeness of which can be assured.

controls.label: Policy and Procedures
controls.description:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] awareness and training policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the awareness and training policy and the associated awareness and training controls;
b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the awareness and training policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current awareness and training:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.label: Literacy Training and Awareness
Practical Exercises
controls.description: Provide practical exercises in literacy training that simulate events and incidents.

controls.label: Insider Threat
controls.description: Provide literacy training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat.

controls.label: Social Engineering and Mining
controls.description: Provide literacy training on recognizing and reporting potential and actual instances of social engineering and social mining.

controls.label: Suspicious Communications and Anomalous System Behavior
controls.description: Provide literacy training on recognizing suspicious communications and anomalous behavior in organizational systems using [Assignment: organization-defined indicators of malicious code].

controls.label: Advanced Persistent Threat
controls.description: Provide literacy training on the advanced persistent threat.

controls.label: Cyber Threat Environment
controls.description:
(a) Provide literacy training on the cyber threat environment; and
(b) Reflect current cyber threat information in system operations.

controls.label: Role-based Training
controls.description:
a. Provide role-based security and privacy training to personnel with the following roles and responsibilities: [Assignment: organization-defined roles and responsibilities]:
  1. Before authorizing access to the system, information, or performing assigned duties, and [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] thereafter; and
  2. When required by system changes;
b. Update role-based training content [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
c. Incorporate lessons learned from internal or external security incidents or breaches into role-based training.

controls.label: Environmental Controls
controls.description: Provide [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] with initial and [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] training in the employment and operation of environmental controls.

controls.label: Physical Security Controls
controls.description: Provide [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] with initial and [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] training in the employment and operation of physical security controls.

controls.label: Practical Exercises
controls.description: Provide practical exercises in security and privacy training that reinforce training objectives.

controls.label: Suspicious Communications and Anomalous System Behavior
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to AT-2(4).

controls.label: Processing Personally Identifiable Information
controls.description: Provide [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] with initial and [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] training in the employment and operation of personally identifiable information processing and transparency controls.

controls.label: Training Records
controls.description:
a. Document and monitor information security and privacy training activities, including security and privacy awareness training and specific role-based security and privacy training; and
b. Retain individual training records for [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.description: Coordinate contingency plan development with organizational elements responsible for related plans.

controls.label: Capacity Planning
controls.description: Conduct capacity planning so that necessary capacity for information processing, telecommunications, and environmental support exists during contingency operations.

controls.label: Resume Mission and Business Functions
controls.description: Plan for the resumption of [Selection: all; essential] mission and business functions within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of contingency plan activation.

controls.label: Resume All Mission and Business Functions
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into CP-2(3).

controls.label: Continue Mission and Business Functions
controls.description: Plan for the continuance of [Selection: all; essential] mission and business functions with minimal or no loss of operational continuity and sustains that continuity until full system restoration at primary processing and/or storage sites.

controls.label: Alternate Processing and Storage Sites
controls.description: Plan for the transfer of [Selection: all; essential] mission and business functions to alternate processing and/or storage sites with minimal or no loss of operational continuity and sustain that continuity through system restoration to primary processing and/or storage sites.

controls.label: Coordinate with External Service Providers
controls.description: Coordinate the contingency plan with the contingency plans of external service providers to ensure that contingency requirements can be satisfied.

controls.label: Identify Critical Assets
controls.description: Identify critical system assets supporting [Selection: all; essential] mission and business functions.

controls.label: Contingency Training
controls.description:
a. Provide contingency training to system users consistent with assigned roles and responsibilities:
  1. Within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of assuming a contingency role or responsibility;
  2. When required by system changes; and
  3. [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] thereafter; and
b. Review and update contingency training content [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.label: Simulated Events
controls.description: Incorporate simulated events into contingency training to facilitate effective response by personnel in crisis situations.

controls.label: Mechanisms Used in Training Environments
controls.description: Employ mechanisms used in operations to provide a more thorough and realistic contingency training environment.

controls.label: Contingency Plan Testing
controls.description:
a. Test the contingency plan for the system [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] using the following tests to determine the effectiveness of the plan and the readiness to execute the plan: [Assignment: organization-defined tests].
b. Review the contingency plan test results; and
c. Initiate corrective actions, if needed.

controls.label: Coordinate with Related Plans
controls.description: Coordinate contingency plan testing with organizational elements responsible for related plans.

controls.label: Alternate Processing Site
controls.description:
Test the contingency plan at the alternate processing site:
(a) To familiarize contingency personnel with the facility and available resources; and
(b) To evaluate the capabilities of the alternate processing site to support contingency operations.

controls.label: Automated Testing
controls.description: Test the contingency plan using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.label: Full Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.description: Include a full recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state as part of contingency plan testing.

controls.label: Self-challenge
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms] to [Assignment: organization-defined system or system component] to disrupt and adversely affect the system or system component.

controls.label: Contingency Plan Update
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into CP-2.

controls.label: Alternate Storage Site
controls.description:
a. Establish an alternate storage site, including necessary agreements to permit the storage and retrieval of system backup information; and
b. Ensure that the alternate storage site provides controls equivalent to that of the primary site.

controls.label: Separation from Primary Site
controls.description: Identify an alternate storage site that is sufficiently separated from the primary storage site to reduce susceptibility to the same threats.

controls.label: Recovery Time and Recovery Point Objectives
controls.description: Configure the alternate storage site to facilitate recovery operations in accordance with recovery time and recovery point objectives.

controls.label: Accessibility
controls.description: Identify potential accessibility problems to the alternate storage site in the event of an area-wide disruption or disaster and outline explicit mitigation actions.

controls.label: Alternate Processing Site
Separation from Primary Site
controls.description: Identify an alternate processing site that is sufficiently separated from the primary processing site to reduce susceptibility to the same threats.

controls.label: Accessibility
controls.description: Identify potential accessibility problems to alternate processing sites in the event of an area-wide disruption or disaster and outlines explicit mitigation actions.

controls.label: Priority of Service
controls.description: Develop alternate processing site agreements that contain priority-of-service provisions in accordance with availability requirements (including recovery time objectives).

controls.label: Preparation for Use
controls.description: Prepare the alternate processing site so that the site can serve as the operational site supporting essential mission and business functions.

controls.label: Equivalent Information Security Safeguards
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into CP-7.

controls.label: Inability to Return to Primary Site
controls.description: Plan and prepare for circumstances that preclude returning to the primary processing site.

controls.label: Telecommunications Services
controls.description: Establish alternate telecommunications services, including necessary agreements to permit the resumption of [Assignment: organization-defined system operations] for essential mission and business functions within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] when the primary telecommunications capabilities are unavailable at either the primary or alternate processing or storage sites.

controls.label: Priority of Service Provisions
controls.description:
(a) Develop primary and alternate telecommunications service agreements that contain priority-of-service provisions in accordance with availability requirements (including recovery time objectives); and
(b) Request Telecommunications Service Priority for all telecommunications services used for national security emergency preparedness if the primary and/or alternate telecommunications services are provided by a common carrier.

controls.label: Single Points of Failure
controls.description: Obtain alternate telecommunications services to reduce the likelihood of sharing a single point of failure with primary telecommunications services.

controls.label: Separation of Primary and Alternate Providers
controls.description: Obtain alternate telecommunications services from providers that are separated from primary service providers to reduce susceptibility to the same threats.

controls.label: Provider Contingency Plan
Alternate Telecommunication Service Testing
controls.description: Test alternate telecommunication services [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.label: System Backup
Testing for Reliability and Integrity
controls.description: Test backup information [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to verify media reliability and information integrity.

controls.label: Test Restoration Using Sampling
controls.description: Use a sample of backup information in the restoration of selected system functions as part of contingency plan testing.

controls.label: Separate Storage for Critical Information
controls.description: Store backup copies of [Assignment: organization-defined critical system software and other security-related information] in a separate facility or in a fire rated container that is not collocated with the operational system.

controls.label: Protection from Unauthorized Modification
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into CP-9.

controls.label: Transfer to Alternate Storage Site
controls.description: Transfer system backup information to the alternate storage site [Assignment: organization-defined time period and transfer rate consistent with the recovery time and recovery point objectives].

controls.label: Redundant Secondary System
controls.description: Conduct system backup by maintaining a redundant secondary system that is not collocated with the primary system and that can be activated without loss of information or disruption to operations.

controls.label: Dual Authorization for Deletion or Destruction
controls.description: Enforce dual authorization for the deletion or destruction of [Assignment: organization-defined backup information].

controls.label: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure and modification of [Assignment: organization-defined backup information].

controls.label: System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.description: Provide for the recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state within [Assignment: organization-defined time period consistent with recovery time and recovery point objectives] after a disruption, compromise, or failure.

controls.label: Contingency Plan Testing
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into CP-4.

controls.label: Transaction Recovery
controls.description: Implement transaction recovery for systems that are transaction-based.

controls.label: Compensating Security Controls
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Restore Within Time Period
controls.description: Provide the capability to restore system components within [Assignment: organization-defined restoration time periods] from configuration-controlled and integrity-protected information representing a known, operational state for the components.

controls.label: Failover Capability
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SI-13.

controls.label: Component Protection
controls.description: Protect system components used for recovery and reconstitution.

controls.label: Alternate Communications Protocols
controls.description: Provide the capability to employ [Assignment: organization-defined alternative communications protocols] in support of maintaining continuity of operations.

controls.label: Safe Mode
controls.description: When [Assignment: organization-defined conditions] are detected, enter a safe mode of operation with [Assignment: organization-defined restrictions].

controls.label: Alternative Security Mechanisms
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined alternative or supplemental security mechanisms] for satisfying [Assignment: organization-defined security functions] when the primary means of implementing the security function is unavailable or compromised.

controls.description:

  1. [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business process-level; system-level] identification and authentication policy that:

controls.label: Multi-factor Authentication to Non-privileged Accounts

controls.label: Local Access to Non-privileged Accounts

Implement multi-factor authentication for [Selection (one or more): local; network; remote] access to [Selection (one or more): privileged accounts; non-privileged accounts] such that:

(b) The device meets [Assignment: organization-defined strength of mechanism requirements].

controls.label: Network Access to Non-privileged Accounts — Separate Device
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-2(6).

controls.label: Single Sign-on

controls.label: Remote Access — Separate Device

controls.label: Acceptance of PIV Credentials
controls.description: Accept and electronically verify Personal Identity Verification-compliant credentials.

controls.label: Out-of-band Authentication
controls.description: Implement the following out-of-band authentication mechanisms under [Assignment: organization-defined conditions]: [Assignment: organization-defined out-of-band authentication].

controls.label: Device Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate [Assignment: organization-defined devices and/or types of devices] before establishing a [Selection (one or more): local; remote; network] connection.

controls.label: Cryptographic Bidirectional Authentication
controls.description: Authenticate [Assignment: organization-defined devices and/or types of devices] before establishing [Selection (one or more): local; remote; network] connection using bidirectional authentication that is cryptographically based.

controls.label: Cryptographic Bidirectional Network Authentication
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-3(1).

controls.label: Dynamic Address Allocation
controls.description:
(a) Where addresses are allocated dynamically, standardize dynamic address allocation lease information and the lease duration assigned to devices in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined lease information and lease duration]; and
(b) Audit lease information when assigned to a device.

controls.label: Device Attestation
controls.description: Handle device identification and authentication based on attestation by [Assignment: organization-defined configuration management process].

controls.label: Identifier Management
Prohibit Account Identifiers as Public Identifiers

controls.label: Supervisor Authorization
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-12(1).

controls.label: Multiple Forms of Certification
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-12(2).

controls.label: Identify User Status
controls.description: Manage individual identifiers by uniquely identifying each individual as [Assignment: organization-defined characteristics].

controls.label: Dynamic Management
controls.description: Manage individual identifiers dynamically in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined dynamic identifier policy].

controls.label: Cross-organization Management
controls.description: Coordinate with the following external organizations for cross-organization management of identifiers: [Assignment: organization-defined external organizations].

controls.label: In-person Registration
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-12(4).

controls.label: Pairwise Pseudonymous Identifiers
controls.description: Generate pairwise pseudonymous identifiers.

controls.label: Attribute Maintenance and Protection
controls.description: Maintain the attributes for each uniquely identified individual, device, or service in [Assignment: organization-defined protected central storage].

controls.label: Authenticator Management
Password-based Authentication
Public Key-based Authentication
controls.description:
(a) For public key-based authentication:
  (1) Enforce authorized access to the corresponding private key; and
  (2) Map the authenticated identity to the account of the individual or group; and
(b) When public key infrastructure (PKI) is used:
  (1) Validate certificates by constructing and verifying a certification path to an accepted trust anchor, including checking certificate status information; and
  (2) Implement a local cache of revocation data to support path discovery and validation.

controls.label: In-person or Trusted External Party Registration
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-12(4).

controls.label: Automated Support for Password Strength Determination
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-5(1).

controls.label: Change Authenticators Prior to Delivery
controls.description: Require developers and installers of system components to provide unique authenticators or change default authenticators prior to delivery and installation.

controls.label: Protection of Authenticators
controls.description: Protect authenticators commensurate with the security category of the information to which use of the authenticator permits access.

controls.label: No Embedded Unencrypted Static Authenticators
controls.description: Ensure that unencrypted static authenticators are not embedded in applications or other forms of static storage.

controls.label: Multiple System Accounts
controls.description: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined security controls] to manage the risk of compromise due to individuals having accounts on multiple systems.

controls.label: Federated Credential Management
controls.description: Use the following external organizations to federate credentials: [Assignment: organization-defined external organizations].

controls.label: Dynamic Credential Binding
controls.description: Bind identities and authenticators dynamically using the following rules: [Assignment: organization-defined binding rules].

controls.label: Hardware Token-based Authentication
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-2(1), IA-2(2).

controls.label: Biometric Authentication Performance
controls.description: For biometric-based authentication, employ mechanisms that satisfy the following biometric quality requirements [Assignment: organization-defined biometric quality requirements].

controls.label: Expiration of Cached Authenticators
controls.description: Prohibit the use of cached authenticators after [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.label: Managing Content of PKI Trust Stores
controls.description: For PKI-based authentication, employ an organization-wide methodology for managing the content of PKI trust stores installed across all platforms, including networks, operating systems, browsers, and applications.

controls.label: GSA-approved Products and Services
controls.description: Use only General Services Administration-approved products and services for identity, credential, and access management.

controls.label: In-person or Trusted External Party Authenticator Issuance
controls.description: Require that the issuance of [Assignment: organization-defined types of and/or specific authenticators] be conducted [Selection: in person; by a trusted external party] before [Assignment: organization-defined registration authority] with authorization by [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles].

controls.label: Presentation Attack Detection for Biometric Authenticators
controls.description: Employ presentation attack detection mechanisms for biometric-based authentication.

controls.label: Password Managers
controls.description:
(a) Employ [Assignment: organization-defined password managers] to generate and manage passwords; and
(b) Protect the passwords using [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.label: Authentication Feedback
controls.description: Obscure feedback of authentication information during the authentication process to protect the information from possible exploitation and use by unauthorized individuals.

controls.label: Cryptographic Module Authentication
controls.description: Implement mechanisms for authentication to a cryptographic module that meet the requirements of applicable laws, executive orders, directives, policies, regulations, standards, and guidelines for such authentication.

controls.label: Identification and Authentication (Non-organizational Users)
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate non-organizational users or processes acting on behalf of non-organizational users.

controls.label: Acceptance of PIV Credentials from Other Agencies
controls.description: Accept and electronically verify Personal Identity Verification-compliant credentials from other federal agencies.

controls.label: Acceptance of External Authenticators
controls.description:
(a) Accept only external authenticators that are NIST-compliant; and
(b) Document and maintain a list of accepted external authenticators.

controls.label: Use of FICAM-approved Products
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-8(2).

controls.label: Use of Defined Profiles
controls.description: Conform to the following profiles for identity management [Assignment: organization-defined identity management profiles].

controls.label: Acceptance of PIV-I Credentials
controls.description: Accept and verify federated or PKI credentials that meet [Assignment: organization-defined policy].

controls.label: Disassociability
controls.description: Implement the following measures to disassociate user attributes or identifier assertion relationships among individuals, credential service providers, and relying parties: [Assignment: organization-defined measures].

controls.label: Service Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate [Assignment: organization-defined system services and applications] before establishing communications with devices, users, or other services or applications.

controls.label: Information Exchange
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-9.

controls.label: Transmission of Decisions
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into IA-9.

controls.label: Adaptive Authentication
controls.description: Require individuals accessing the system to employ [Assignment: organization-defined supplemental authentication techniques or mechanisms] under specific [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances or situations].

controls.label: Re-authentication
controls.description: Require users to re-authenticate when [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances or situations].

Supervisor Authorization
controls.description: Require that the registration process to receive an account for logical access includes supervisor or sponsor authorization.

controls.label: Identity Evidence
controls.description: Require evidence of individual identification be presented to the registration authority.

controls.label: Identity Evidence Validation and Verification
controls.description: Require that the presented identity evidence be validated and verified through [Assignment: organization-defined methods of validation and verification].

controls.label: In-person Validation and Verification
controls.description: Require that the validation and verification of identity evidence be conducted in person before a designated registration authority.

controls.label: Address Confirmation
controls.description: Require that a [Selection: registration code; notice of proofing] be delivered through an out-of-band channel to verify the users address (physical or digital) of record.

controls.label: Accept Externally-proofed Identities
controls.description: Accept externally-proofed identities at [Assignment: organization-defined identity assurance level].

controls.label: Identity Providers and Authorization Servers
controls.description: Employ identity providers and authorization servers to manage user, device, and non-person entity (NPE) identities, attributes, and access rights supporting authentication and authorization decisions in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined policy] using [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms].

controls.label: Protection of Cryptographic Keys
controls.description: Cryptographic keys that protect access tokens are generated, managed, and protected from disclosure and misuse.

controls.label: Verification of Identity Assertions and Access Tokens
controls.description: The source and integrity of identity assertions and access tokens are verified before granting access to system and information resources.

  3. [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] thereafter; and

controls.label: Simulated Events
controls.description: Incorporate simulated events into incident response training to facilitate the required response by personnel in crisis situations.

controls.description: Identify [Assignment: organization-defined classes of incidents] and take the following actions in response to those incidents to ensure continuation of organizational mission and business functions: [Assignment: organization-defined actions].

controls.description: Correlate incident information and individual incident responses to achieve an organization-wide perspective on incident awareness and response.

controls.description: Implement a configurable capability to automatically disable the system if [Assignment: organization-defined security violations] are detected.

controls.description: Coordinate with [Assignment: organization-defined external organizations] to correlate and share [Assignment: organization-defined incident information] to achieve a cross-organization perspective on incident awareness and more effective incident responses.

controls.label: Dynamic Response Capability
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined dynamic response capabilities] to respond to incidents.

controls.label: Supply Chain Coordination
controls.description: Coordinate incident handling activities involving supply chain events with other organizations involved in the supply chain.

controls.label: Integrated Incident Response Team
controls.description: Establish and maintain an integrated incident response team that can be deployed to any location identified by the organization in [Assignment: organization-defined time period].

controls.description: Analyze malicious code and/or other residual artifacts remaining in the system after the incident.

Breaches

controls.description:
(a) Require that nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic services be performed from a system that implements a security capability comparable to the capability implemented on the system being serviced; or
(b) Remove the component to be serviced from the system prior to nonlocal maintenance or diagnostic services; sanitize the component (for organizational information); and after the service is performed, inspect and sanitize the component (for potentially malicious software) before reconnecting the component to the system.

controls.label: Authentication and Separation of Maintenance Sessions
controls.description:
Protect nonlocal maintenance sessions by:
(a) Employing [Assignment: organization-defined authenticators that are replay resistant]; and
(b) Separating the maintenance sessions from other network sessions with the system by either:
  (1) Physically separated communications paths; or
  (2) Logically separated communications paths.

controls.label: Approvals and Notifications
controls.description:
(a) Require the approval of each nonlocal maintenance session by [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; and
(b) Notify the following personnel or roles of the date and time of planned nonlocal maintenance: [Assignment: organization-defined personnel and roles].

controls.label: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Implement the following cryptographic mechanisms to protect the integrity and confidentiality of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic communications: [Assignment: organization-defined cryptographic mechanisms].

controls.label: Disconnect Verification
controls.description: Verify session and network connection termination after the completion of nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic sessions.

controls.label: Maintenance Personnel
Individuals Without Appropriate Access
controls.description:
(a) Implement procedures for the use of maintenance personnel that lack appropriate security clearances or are not U.S. citizens, that include the following requirements:
  (1) Maintenance personnel who do not have needed access authorizations, clearances, or formal access approvals are escorted and supervised during the performance of maintenance and diagnostic activities on the system by approved organizational personnel who are fully cleared, have appropriate access authorizations, and are technically qualified; and
  (2) Prior to initiating maintenance or diagnostic activities by personnel who do not have needed access authorizations, clearances or formal access approvals, all volatile information storage components within the system are sanitized and all nonvolatile storage media are removed or physically disconnected from the system and secured; and
(b) Develop and implement [Assignment: organization-defined alternate controls] in the event a system component cannot be sanitized, removed, or disconnected from the system.

controls.label: Security Clearances for Classified Systems
controls.description: Verify that personnel performing maintenance and diagnostic activities on a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information possess security clearances and formal access approvals for at least the highest classification level and for compartments of information on the system.

controls.label: Citizenship Requirements for Classified Systems
controls.description: Verify that personnel performing maintenance and diagnostic activities on a system processing, storing, or transmitting classified information are U.S. citizens.

controls.label: Foreign Nationals
controls.description:
Ensure that:
(a) Foreign nationals with appropriate security clearances are used to conduct maintenance and diagnostic activities on classified systems only when the systems are jointly owned and operated by the United States and foreign allied governments, or owned and operated solely by foreign allied governments; and
(b) Approvals, consents, and detailed operational conditions regarding the use of foreign nationals to conduct maintenance and diagnostic activities on classified systems are fully documented within Memoranda of Agreements.

controls.label: Non-system Maintenance
controls.description: Ensure that non-escorted personnel performing maintenance activities not directly associated with the system but in the physical proximity of the system, have required access authorizations.

controls.label: Timely Maintenance
controls.description: Obtain maintenance support and/or spare parts for [Assignment: organization-defined system components] within [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of failure.

controls.label: Preventive Maintenance
controls.description: Perform preventive maintenance on [Assignment: organization-defined system components] at [Assignment: organization-defined time intervals].

controls.label: Predictive Maintenance
controls.description: Perform predictive maintenance on [Assignment: organization-defined system components] at [Assignment: organization-defined time intervals].

controls.label: Automated Support for Predictive Maintenance
controls.description: Transfer predictive maintenance data to a maintenance management system using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.label: Field Maintenance
controls.description: Restrict or prohibit field maintenance on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] to [Assignment: organization-defined trusted maintenance facilities].

controls.label: Media Storage

controls.label: Media Sanitization
controls.description:

controls.label: Review, Approve, Track, Document, and Verify

controls.label: Equipment Testing
controls.description: Test sanitization equipment and procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to ensure that the intended sanitization is being achieved.

controls.label: Nondestructive Techniques
controls.description: Apply nondestructive sanitization techniques to portable storage devices prior to connecting such devices to the system under the following circumstances: [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances].

controls.label: Remote Purging or Wiping of Information
controls.description: Provide the capability to purge or wipe information from [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] [Selection: remotely; under {{ insert: param, mp-06.08_odp.03 }} ].

controls.label: Media Use
controls.description:

controls.description: Test downgrading equipment and procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] to ensure that downgrading actions are being achieved.

  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and

controls.label: Physical Access Authorizations
Access by Position or Role
controls.description: Authorize physical access to the facility where the system resides based on position or role.

controls.label: Two Forms of Identification
controls.description: Require two forms of identification from the following forms of identification for visitor access to the facility where the system resides: [Assignment: organization-defined list of acceptable forms of identification].

controls.label: Restrict Unescorted Access
controls.description: Restrict unescorted access to the facility where the system resides to personnel with [Selection (one or more): security clearances for all information contained within the system; formal access authorizations for all information contained within the system; need for access to all information contained within the system; {{ insert: param, pe-02.03_odp.02 }} ].

controls.label: Physical Access Control
System Access
controls.description: Enforce physical access authorizations to the system in addition to the physical access controls for the facility at [Assignment: organization-defined physical spaces].

controls.label: Facility and Systems
controls.description: Perform security checks [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] at the physical perimeter of the facility or system for exfiltration of information or removal of system components.

controls.label: Continuous Guards
controls.description: Employ guards to control [Assignment: organization-defined physical access points] to the facility where the system resides 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

controls.label: Lockable Casings
controls.description: Use lockable physical casings to protect [Assignment: organization-defined system components] from unauthorized physical access.

controls.label: Tamper Protection
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined anti-tamper technologies] to [Selection (one or more): detect; prevent] physical tampering or alteration of [Assignment: organization-defined hardware components] within the system.

controls.label: Facility Penetration Testing
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into CA-8.

controls.label: Physical Barriers
controls.description: Limit access using physical barriers.

controls.label: Access Control Vestibules
controls.description: Employ access control vestibules at [Assignment: organization-defined locations].

controls.label: Access Control for Transmission
controls.description: Control physical access to [Assignment: organization-defined system distribution and transmission lines] within organizational facilities using [Assignment: organization-defined security controls].

controls.label: Access Control for Output Devices
controls.description: Control physical access to output from [Assignment: organization-defined output devices] to prevent unauthorized individuals from obtaining the output.

controls.label: Access to Output by Authorized Individuals

controls.description: Link individual identity to receipt of output from output devices.

controls.label: Monitoring Physical Access
Intrusion Alarms and Surveillance Equipment
controls.description: Monitor physical access to the facility where the system resides using physical intrusion alarms and surveillance equipment.

controls.label: Automated Intrusion Recognition and Responses
controls.description: Recognize [Assignment: organization-defined classes or types of intrusions] and initiate [Assignment: organization-defined response actions] using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.label: Video Surveillance
Monitoring Physical Access to Systems
controls.description: Monitor physical access to the system in addition to the physical access monitoring of the facility at [Assignment: organization-defined physical spaces].

Automated Records Maintenance and Review
controls.description: Maintain and review visitor access records using [Assignment: organization-defined automated mechanisms].

controls.label: Limit Personally Identifiable Information Elements
controls.description: Limit personally identifiable information contained in visitor access records to the following elements identified in the privacy risk assessment: [Assignment: organization-defined elements].

controls.label: Power Equipment and Cabling
controls.description: Protect power equipment and power cabling for the system from damage and destruction.

controls.label: Redundant Cabling
controls.description: Employ redundant power cabling paths that are physically separated by [Assignment: organization-defined distance].

controls.label: Automatic Voltage Controls
controls.description: Employ automatic voltage controls for [Assignment: organization-defined critical system components].
