controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into RA-9.

controls.label: Critical Components with No Viable Alternative Sourcing
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SA-20.

controls.label: Development Process, Standards, and Tools
Quality Metrics
controls.description:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:
(a) Define quality metrics at the beginning of the development process; and
(b) Provide evidence of meeting the quality metrics [Selection (one or more): {{ insert: param, sa-15.01_odp.02 }}; {{ insert: param, sa-15.01_odp.03 }}; upon delivery].

controls.label: Security and Privacy Tracking Tools
controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to select and employ security and privacy tracking tools for use during the development process.

controls.label: Criticality Analysis
controls.description:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to perform a criticality analysis:
(a) At the following decision points in the system development life cycle: [Assignment: organization-defined decision points]; and
(b) At the following level of rigor: [Assignment: organization-defined breadth and depth of criticality analysis].

controls.label: Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Analysis
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SA-11(2).

controls.label: Attack Surface Reduction
controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to reduce attack surfaces to [Assignment: organization-defined thresholds].

controls.label: Continuous Improvement
controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to implement an explicit process to continuously improve the development process.

controls.label: Automated Vulnerability Analysis
Reuse of Threat and Vulnerability Information
controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to use threat modeling and vulnerability analyses from similar systems, components, or services to inform the current development process.

controls.label: Use of Live Data
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SA-3(2).

controls.label: Incident Response Plan
controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to provide, implement, and test an incident response plan.

controls.label: Archive System or Component
controls.description: Require the developer of the system or system component to archive the system or component to be released or delivered together with the corresponding evidence supporting the final security and privacy review.

controls.label: Minimize Personally Identifiable Information
controls.description: Require the developer of the system or system component to minimize the use of personally identifiable information in development and test environments.

controls.label: Logging Syntax
controls.description: Require the developer of the system or system component to minimize the use of personally identifiable information in development and test environments.

controls.label: Developer-provided Training
controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to provide the following training on the correct use and operation of the implemented security and privacy functions, controls, and/or mechanisms: [Assignment: organization-defined training].

controls.label: Developer Security and Privacy Architecture and Design
controls.description:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to produce a design specification and security and privacy architecture that:
a. Is consistent with the organization’s security and privacy architecture that is an integral part the organization’s enterprise architecture;
b. Accurately and completely describes the required security and privacy functionality, and the allocation of controls among physical and logical components; and
c. Expresses how individual security and privacy functions, mechanisms, and services work together to provide required security and privacy capabilities and a unified approach to protection.

controls.label: Formal Policy Model
controls.description:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:
(a) Produce, as an integral part of the development process, a formal policy model describing the [Assignment: organization-defined elements of organizational security and privacy policy] to be enforced; and
(b) Prove that the formal policy model is internally consistent and sufficient to enforce the defined elements of the organizational security and privacy policy when implemented.

controls.label: Security-relevant Components
controls.description:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:
(a) Define security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware; and
(b) Provide a rationale that the definition for security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware is complete.

controls.label: Formal Correspondence
Informal Correspondence
Conceptually Simple Design
controls.description:
Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to:
(a) Design and structure the security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to use a complete, conceptually simple protection mechanism with precisely defined semantics; and
(b) Internally structure the security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware with specific regard for this mechanism.

controls.label: Structure for Testing
controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to structure security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to facilitate testing.

controls.label: Structure for Least Privilege
controls.description: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service to structure security-relevant hardware, software, and firmware to facilitate controlling access with least privilege.

controls.label: Orchestration
controls.description: Design [Assignment: organization-defined critical systems] with coordinated behavior to implement the following capabilities: [Assignment: organization-defined capabilities].

controls.label: Design Diversity
controls.description: Use different designs for [Assignment: organization-defined critical systems] to satisfy a common set of requirements or to provide equivalent functionality.

controls.label: Tamper Resistance and Detection
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to SR-9.

controls.label: Multiple Phases of System Development Life Cycle
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to SR-9(1).

controls.label: Inspection of Systems or Components
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to SR-10.

controls.label: Component Authenticity
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to SR-11.

controls.label: Anti-counterfeit Training
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to SR-11(1).

controls.label: Configuration Control for Component Service and Repair
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to SR-11(2).

controls.label: Component Disposal
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to SR-12.

controls.label: Anti-counterfeit Scanning
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to SR-11(3).

controls.label: Customized Development of Critical Components
controls.description: Reimplement or custom develop the following critical system components: [Assignment: organization-defined critical system].

controls.label: Developer Screening
controls.description:
Require that the developer of [Assignment: organization-defined system, systems component, or system service]:
a. Has appropriate access authorizations as determined by assigned [Assignment: organization-defined official government duties]; and
b. Satisfies the following additional personnel screening criteria: [Assignment: organization-defined additional personnel screening criteria].

controls.label: Validation of Screening
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SA-21.

controls.label: Unsupported System Components
controls.description:
a. Replace system components when support for the components is no longer available from the developer, vendor, or manufacturer; or
b. Provide the following options for alternative sources for continued support for unsupported components [Selection (one or more): in-house support; {{ insert: param, sa-22_odp.02 }} ].

controls.label: Alternative Sources for Continued Support
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SA-22.

controls.label: Specialization
controls.description: Employ [Selection (one or more): design modification; augmentation; reconfiguration] on [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] supporting mission essential services or functions to increase the trustworthiness in those systems or components.

controls.label: Design For Cyber Resiliency
controls.description:
a. Design organizational systems, system components, or system services to achieve cyber resiliency by:
  1. Defining the following cyber resiliency goals: [Assignment: organization-defined cyber resiliency goals].
  2. Defining the following cyber resiliency objectives: [Assignment: organization-defined cyber resiliency objectives].
  3. Defining the following cyber resiliency techniques: [Assignment: organization-defined cyber resiliency techniques].
  4. Defining the following cyber resiliency implementation approaches: [Assignment: organization-defined cyber resiliency implementation approaches].
  5. Defining the following cyber resiliency design principles: [Assignment: organization-defined cyber resiliency design principles].
b. Implement the selected cyber resiliency goals, objectives, techniques, implementation approaches, and design principles as part of an organizational risk management process or systems security engineering process.

controls.label: Policy and Procedures
controls.description:
a. Develop, document, and disseminate to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]:
  1. [Selection (one or more): organization-level; mission/business-process-level; system-level] system and communications protection policy that:
    (a) Addresses purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination among organizational entities, and compliance; and
    (b) Is consistent with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines; and
  2. Procedures to facilitate the implementation of the system and communications protection policy and the associated system and communications protection controls;
b. Designate an [Assignment: organization-defined official] to manage the development, documentation, and dissemination of the system and communications protection policy and procedures; and
c. Review and update the current system and communications protection:
  1. Policy [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events]; and
  2. Procedures [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] and following [Assignment: organization-defined events].

controls.label: Separation of System and User Functionality
controls.description: Separate user functionality, including user interface services, from system management functionality.

controls.label: Interfaces for Non-privileged Users
controls.description: Prevent the presentation of system management functionality at interfaces to non-privileged users.

controls.label: Disassociability
controls.description: Store state information from applications and software separately.

controls.label: Security Function Isolation
controls.description: Isolate security functions from nonsecurity functions.

controls.label: Hardware Separation
controls.description: Employ hardware separation mechanisms to implement security function isolation.

controls.label: Access and Flow Control Functions
controls.description: Isolate security functions enforcing access and information flow control from nonsecurity functions and from other security functions.

controls.label: Minimize Nonsecurity Functionality
controls.description: Minimize the number of nonsecurity functions included within the isolation boundary containing security functions.

controls.label: Module Coupling and Cohesiveness
controls.description: Implement security functions as largely independent modules that maximize internal cohesiveness within modules and minimize coupling between modules.

controls.label: Layered Structures
controls.description: Implement security functions as a layered structure minimizing interactions between layers of the design and avoiding any dependence by lower layers on the functionality or correctness of higher layers.

controls.label: Information in Shared System Resources
controls.description: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.

controls.label: Security Levels
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-4.

controls.label: Multilevel or Periods Processing
controls.description: Prevent unauthorized information transfer via shared resources in accordance with [Assignment: organization-defined procedures] when system processing explicitly switches between different information classification levels or security categories.

controls.label: Denial-of-service Protection
controls.description:
a. [Selection: protect against; limit] the effects of the following types of denial-of-service events: [Assignment: organization-defined types of denial-of-service events]; and
b. Employ the following controls to achieve the denial-of-service objective: [Assignment: organization-defined controls by type of denial-of-service event].

controls.label: Restrict Ability to Attack Other Systems
controls.description: Restrict the ability of individuals to launch the following denial-of-service attacks against other systems: [Assignment: organization-defined denial-of-service attacks].

controls.label: Capacity, Bandwidth, and Redundancy
controls.description: Manage capacity, bandwidth, or other redundancy to limit the effects of information flooding denial-of-service attacks.

controls.label: Detection and Monitoring
controls.description:
(a) Employ the following monitoring tools to detect indicators of denial-of-service attacks against, or launched from, the system: [Assignment: organization-defined monitoring tools]; and
(b) Monitor the following system resources to determine if sufficient resources exist to prevent effective denial-of-service attacks: [Assignment: organization-defined system resources].

controls.label: Resource Availability
controls.description: Protect the availability of resources by allocating [Assignment: organization-defined resources] by [Selection (one or more): priority; quota; {{ insert: param, sc-06_odp.03 }} ].

controls.label: Boundary Protection
Physically Separated Subnetworks
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-7.

controls.label: Public Access
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-7.

controls.label: Access Points
controls.description: Limit the number of external network connections to the system.

controls.label: External Telecommunications Services
Deny by Default — Allow by Exception
controls.description: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception [Selection (one or more): at managed interfaces; for {{ insert: param, sc-07.05_odp.02 }} ].

controls.label: Response to Recognized Failures
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-7(18).

controls.label: Split Tunneling for Remote Devices
controls.description: Prevent split tunneling for remote devices connecting to organizational systems unless the split tunnel is securely provisioned using [Assignment: organization-defined safeguards].

controls.label: Route Traffic to Authenticated Proxy Servers
controls.description: Route [Assignment: organization-defined internal communications traffic] to [Assignment: organization-defined external networks] through authenticated proxy servers at managed interfaces.

controls.label: Restrict Threatening Outgoing Communications Traffic
controls.description:
(a) Detect and deny outgoing communications traffic posing a threat to external systems; and
(b) Audit the identity of internal users associated with denied communications.

controls.label: Prevent Exfiltration
controls.description:
(a) Prevent the exfiltration of information; and
(b) Conduct exfiltration tests [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.label: Restrict Incoming Communications Traffic
controls.description: Only allow incoming communications from [Assignment: organization-defined authorized sources] to be routed to [Assignment: organization-defined authorized destinations].

controls.label: Host-based Protection
controls.description: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined host-based boundary protection mechanisms] at [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.label: Isolation of Security Tools, Mechanisms, and Support Components
controls.description: Isolate [Assignment: organization-defined information security tools, mechanisms, and support components] from other internal system components by implementing physically separate subnetworks with managed interfaces to other components of the system.

controls.label: Protect Against Unauthorized Physical Connections
controls.description: Protect against unauthorized physical connections at [Assignment: organization-defined managed interfaces].

controls.label: Networked Privileged Accesses
controls.description: Route networked, privileged accesses through a dedicated, managed interface for purposes of access control and auditing.

controls.label: Prevent Discovery of System Components
controls.description: Prevent the discovery of specific system components that represent a managed interface.

controls.label: Automated Enforcement of Protocol Formats
controls.description: Enforce adherence to protocol formats.

controls.label: Fail Secure
controls.description: Prevent systems from entering unsecure states in the event of an operational failure of a boundary protection device.

controls.label: Block Communication from Non-organizationally Configured Hosts
controls.description: Block inbound and outbound communications traffic between [Assignment: organization-defined communication clients] that are independently configured by end users and external service providers.

controls.label: Dynamic Isolation and Segregation
controls.description: Provide the capability to dynamically isolate [Assignment: organization-defined system components] from other system components.

controls.label: Isolation of System Components
controls.description: Employ boundary protection mechanisms to isolate [Assignment: organization-defined system components] supporting [Assignment: organization-defined missions and/or business functions].

controls.label: Separate Subnets for Connecting to Different Security Domains
controls.description: Implement separate network addresses to connect to systems in different security domains.

controls.label: Disable Sender Feedback on Protocol Validation Failure
controls.description: Disable feedback to senders on protocol format validation failure.

controls.label: Personally Identifiable Information
Unclassified National Security System Connections
controls.description: Prohibit the direct connection of [Assignment: organization-defined unclassified national security system] to an external network without the use of [Assignment: organization-defined boundary protection device].

controls.label: Classified National Security System Connections
controls.description: Prohibit the direct connection of a classified national security system to an external network without the use of [Assignment: organization-defined boundary protection device].

controls.label: Unclassified Non-national Security System Connections
controls.description: Prohibit the direct connection of [Assignment: organization-defined unclassified, non-national security system] to an external network without the use of [Assignment: organization-defined boundary protection device].

controls.label: Connections to Public Networks
controls.description: Prohibit the direct connection of [Assignment: organization-defined system] to a public network.

controls.label: Separate Subnets to Isolate Functions
controls.description: Implement [Selection: physically; logically] separate subnetworks to isolate the following critical system components and functions: [Assignment: organization-defined critical system components and functions].

controls.label: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: Protect the [Selection (one or more): confidentiality; integrity] of transmitted information.

controls.label: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to [Selection (one or more): prevent unauthorized disclosure of information; detect changes to information] during transmission.

controls.label: Pre- and Post-transmission Handling
controls.description: Maintain the [Selection (one or more): confidentiality; integrity] of information during preparation for transmission and during reception.

controls.label: Cryptographic Protection for Message Externals
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect message externals unless otherwise protected by [Assignment: organization-defined alternative physical controls].

controls.label: Conceal or Randomize Communications
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to conceal or randomize communication patterns unless otherwise protected by [Assignment: organization-defined alternative physical controls].

controls.label: Protected Distribution System
controls.description: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined protected distribution system] to [Selection (one or more): prevent unauthorized disclosure of information; detect changes to information] during transmission.

controls.label: Transmission Confidentiality
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-8.

controls.label: Network Disconnect
controls.description: Terminate the network connection associated with a communications session at the end of the session or after [Assignment: organization-defined time period] of inactivity.

controls.label: Trusted Path
controls.description:
a. Provide a [Selection: physically; logically] isolated trusted communications path for communications between the user and the trusted components of the system; and
b. Permit users to invoke the trusted communications path for communications between the user and the following security functions of the system, including at a minimum, authentication and re-authentication: [Assignment: organization-defined security functions].

controls.label: Irrefutable Communications Path
controls.description:
(a) Provide a trusted communications path that is irrefutably distinguishable from other communications paths; and
(b) Initiate the trusted communications path for communications between the [Assignment: organization-defined security functions] of the system and the user.

controls.label: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.description: Establish and manage cryptographic keys when cryptography is employed within the system in accordance with the following key management requirements: [Assignment: organization-defined requirements].

controls.label: Availability
controls.description: Maintain availability of information in the event of the loss of cryptographic keys by users.

controls.label: Symmetric Keys
controls.description: Produce, control, and distribute symmetric cryptographic keys using [Selection: NIST FIPS-validated; NSA-approved] key management technology and processes.

controls.label: Asymmetric Keys
controls.description: Produce, control, and distribute asymmetric cryptographic keys using [Selection: NSA-approved key management technology and processes; prepositioned keying material; DoD-approved or DoD-issued Medium Assurance PKI certificates; DoD-approved or DoD-issued Medium Hardware Assurance PKI certificates and hardware security tokens that protect the user’s private key; certificates issued in accordance with organization-defined requirements].

controls.label: PKI Certificates
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-12(3).

controls.label: PKI Certificates / Hardware Tokens
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-12(3).

controls.label: Physical Control of Keys
controls.description: Maintain physical control of cryptographic keys when stored information is encrypted by external service providers.

controls.label: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description:
a. Determine the [Assignment: organization-defined cryptographic uses]; and
b. Implement the following types of cryptography required for each specified cryptographic use: [Assignment: organization-defined types of cryptography].

controls.label: FIPS-validated Cryptography
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-13.

controls.label: NSA-approved Cryptography
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-13.

controls.label: Individuals Without Formal Access Approvals
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-13.

controls.label: Digital Signatures
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-13.

controls.label: Public Access Protections
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-2, AC-3, AC-5, AC-6, SI-3, SI-4, SI-5, SI-7, SI-10.

controls.label: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications
controls.description:
a. Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and applications with the following exceptions: [Assignment: organization-defined exceptions where remote activation is to be allowed]; and
b. Provide an explicit indication of use to users physically present at the devices.

controls.label: Physical or Logical Disconnect
controls.description: Provide [Selection (one or more): physical; logical] disconnect of collaborative computing devices in a manner that supports ease of use.

controls.label: Blocking Inbound and Outbound Communications Traffic
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-7.

controls.label: Disabling and Removal in Secure Work Areas
controls.description: Disable or remove collaborative computing devices and applications from [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components] in [Assignment: organization-defined secure work areas].

controls.label: Explicitly Indicate Current Participants
controls.description: Provide an explicit indication of current participants in [Assignment: organization-defined online meetings and teleconferences].

controls.label: Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes
controls.description: Associate [Assignment: organization-defined security and privacy attributes] with information exchanged between systems and between system components.

controls.label: Integrity Verification
controls.description: Verify the integrity of transmitted security and privacy attributes.

controls.label: Anti-spoofing Mechanisms
controls.description: Implement anti-spoofing mechanisms to prevent adversaries from falsifying the security attributes indicating the successful application of the security process.

controls.label: Cryptographic Binding
controls.description: Implement [Assignment: organization-defined mechanisms or techniques] to bind security and privacy attributes to transmitted information.

controls.label: Public Key Infrastructure Certificates
controls.description:
a. Issue public key certificates under an [Assignment: organization-defined certificate policy] or obtain public key certificates from an approved service provider; and
b. Include only approved trust anchors in trust stores or certificate stores managed by the organization.

controls.label: Mobile Code
controls.description:
a. Define acceptable and unacceptable mobile code and mobile code technologies; and
b. Authorize, monitor, and control the use of mobile code within the system.

controls.label: Identify Unacceptable Code and Take Corrective Actions
controls.description: Identify [Assignment: organization-defined unacceptable mobile code] and take [Assignment: organization-defined corrective actions].

controls.label: Acquisition, Development, and Use
controls.description: Verify that the acquisition, development, and use of mobile code to be deployed in the system meets [Assignment: organization-defined mobile code requirements].

controls.label: Prevent Downloading and Execution
controls.description: Prevent the download and execution of [Assignment: organization-defined unacceptable mobile code].

controls.label: Prevent Automatic Execution
controls.description: Prevent the automatic execution of mobile code in [Assignment: organization-defined software applications] and enforce [Assignment: organization-defined actions] prior to executing the code.

controls.label: Allow Execution Only in Confined Environments
controls.description: Allow execution of permitted mobile code only in confined virtual machine environments.

controls.label: Voice Over Internet Protocol
controls.description: Withdrawn.

controls.label: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Authoritative Source)
controls.description:
a. Provide additional data origin authentication and integrity verification artifacts along with the authoritative name resolution data the system returns in response to external name/address resolution queries; and
b. Provide the means to indicate the security status of child zones and (if the child supports secure resolution services) to enable verification of a chain of trust among parent and child domains, when operating as part of a distributed, hierarchical namespace.

controls.label: Child Subspaces
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-20.

controls.label: Data Origin and Integrity
controls.description: Provide data origin and integrity protection artifacts for internal name/address resolution queries.

controls.label: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Recursive or Caching Resolver)
controls.description: Request and perform data origin authentication and data integrity verification on the name/address resolution responses the system receives from authoritative sources.

controls.label: Data Origin and Integrity
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-21.

controls.label: Architecture and Provisioning for Name/Address Resolution Service
controls.description: Ensure the systems that collectively provide name/address resolution service for an organization are fault-tolerant and implement internal and external role separation.

controls.label: Session Authenticity
controls.description: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

controls.label: Invalidate Session Identifiers at Logout
controls.description: Invalidate session identifiers upon user logout or other session termination.

controls.label: User-initiated Logouts and Message Displays
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into AC-12(1).

controls.label: Unique System-generated Session Identifiers
controls.description: Generate a unique session identifier for each session with [Assignment: organization-defined randomness requirements] and recognize only session identifiers that are system-generated.

controls.label: Unique Session Identifiers with Randomization
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-23(3).

controls.label: Allowed Certificate Authorities
controls.description: Only allow the use of [Assignment: organization-defined certificated authorities] for verification of the establishment of protected sessions.

controls.label: Fail in Known State
controls.description: Fail to a [Assignment: organization-defined known system state] for the following failures on the indicated components while preserving [Assignment: organization-defined system state information] in failure: [Assignment: organization-defined types of system failures on system components].

controls.label: Thin Nodes
controls.description: Employ minimal functionality and information storage on the following system components: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.label: Decoys
controls.description: Include components within organizational systems specifically designed to be the target of malicious attacks for detecting, deflecting, and analyzing such attacks.

controls.label: Detection of Malicious Code
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-35.

controls.label: Platform-independent Applications
controls.description: Include within organizational systems the following platform independent applications: [Assignment: organization-defined platform-independent applications].

controls.label: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: Protect the [Selection (one or more): confidentiality; integrity] of the following information at rest: [Assignment: organization-defined information at rest].

controls.label: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure and modification of the following information at rest on [Assignment: organization-defined system components or media]: [Assignment: organization-defined information].

controls.label: Offline Storage
controls.description: Remove the following information from online storage and store offline in a secure location: [Assignment: organization-defined information].

controls.label: Cryptographic Keys
controls.description: Provide protected storage for cryptographic keys [Selection: {{ insert: param, sc-28.03_odp.02 }}; hardware-protected key store].

controls.label: Heterogeneity
controls.description: Employ a diverse set of information technologies for the following system components in the implementation of the system: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.label: Virtualization Techniques
controls.description: Employ virtualization techniques to support the deployment of a diversity of operating systems and applications that are changed [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.label: Concealment and Misdirection
controls.description: Employ the following concealment and misdirection techniques for [Assignment: organization-defined systems] at [Assignment: organization-defined time periods] to confuse and mislead adversaries: [Assignment: organization-defined concealment and misdirection techniques].

controls.label: Virtualization Techniques
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-29(1).

controls.label: Randomness
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined techniques] to introduce randomness into organizational operations and assets.

controls.label: Change Processing and Storage Locations
controls.description: Change the location of [Assignment: organization-defined processing and/or storage] [Selection: {{ insert: param, sc-30.03_odp.03 }}; random time intervals]].

controls.label: Misleading Information
controls.description: Employ realistic, but misleading information in [Assignment: organization-defined system components] about its security state or posture.

controls.label: Concealment of System Components
controls.description: Employ the following techniques to hide or conceal [Assignment: organization-defined system components]: [Assignment: organization-defined techniques].

controls.label: Covert Channel Analysis
controls.description:
a. Perform a covert channel analysis to identify those aspects of communications within the system that are potential avenues for covert [Selection (one or more): storage; timing] channels; and
b. Estimate the maximum bandwidth of those channels.

controls.label: Test Covert Channels for Exploitability
controls.description: Test a subset of the identified covert channels to determine the channels that are exploitable.

controls.label: Maximum Bandwidth
controls.description: Reduce the maximum bandwidth for identified covert [Selection (one or more): storage; timing] channels to [Assignment: organization-defined values].

controls.label: Measure Bandwidth in Operational Environments
controls.description: Measure the bandwidth of [Assignment: organization-defined subset of identified covert channels] in the operational environment of the system.

controls.label: System Partitioning
controls.description: Partition the system into [Assignment: organization-defined system components] residing in separate [Selection: physical; logical] domains or environments based on [Assignment: organization-defined circumstances for the physical or logical separation of components].

controls.label: Separate Physical Domains for Privileged Functions
controls.description: Partition privileged functions into separate physical domains.

controls.label: Transmission Preparation Integrity
controls.description: Withdrawn — incorporated into SC-8.

controls.label: Non-modifiable Executable Programs
controls.description:
For [Assignment: organization-defined system components], load and execute:
a. The operating environment from hardware-enforced, read-only media; and
b. The following applications from hardware-enforced, read-only media: [Assignment: organization-defined applications].

controls.label: No Writable Storage
controls.description: Employ [Assignment: organization-defined system components] with no writeable storage that is persistent across component restart or power on/off.

controls.label: Integrity Protection on Read-only Media
controls.description: Protect the integrity of information prior to storage on read-only media and control the media after such information has been recorded onto the media.

controls.label: Hardware-based Protection
controls.description: Withdrawn — moved to SC-51.

controls.label: External Malicious Code Identification

controls.description: Employ the following controls to ensure an adequate supply of [Assignment: organization-defined critical system components]: [Assignment: organization-defined controls].

controls.label: Assessments Prior to Selection, Acceptance, Modification, or Update
controls.description: Assess the system, system component, or system service prior to selection, acceptance, modification, or update.

controls.label: Supplier Assessments and Reviews
controls.description: Assess and review the supply chain-related risks associated with suppliers or contractors and the system, system component, or system service they provide [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.label: Testing and Analysis
controls.description: Employ [Selection (one or more): organizational analysis; independent third-party analysis; organizational testing; independent third-party testing] of the following supply chain elements, processes, and actors associated with the system, system component, or system service: [Assignment: organization-defined supply chain elements, processes, and actors].

controls.label: Supply Chain Operations Security
controls.description: Employ the following Operations Security (OPSEC) controls to protect supply chain-related information for the system, system component, or system service: [Assignment: organization-defined OPSEC controls].

controls.label: Notification Agreements
controls.description: Establish agreements and procedures with entities involved in the supply chain for the system, system component, or system service for the [Selection (one or more): notification of supply chain compromises; {{ insert: param, sr-08_odp.02 }} ].

controls.label: Tamper Resistance and Detection
controls.description: Implement a tamper protection program for the system, system component, or system service.

controls.label: Multiple Stages of System Development Life Cycle
controls.description: Employ anti-tamper technologies, tools, and techniques throughout the system development life cycle.

controls.label: Inspection of Systems or Components
controls.description: Inspect the following systems or system components [Selection (one or more): at random; at {{ insert: param, sr-10_odp.03 }}; upon {{ insert: param, sr-10_odp.04 }} ] to detect tampering: [Assignment: organization-defined systems or system components].

controls.label: Component Authenticity
controls.description:
a. Develop and implement anti-counterfeit policy and procedures that include the means to detect and prevent counterfeit components from entering the system; and
b. Report counterfeit system components to [Selection (one or more): source of counterfeit component; {{ insert: param, sr-11_odp.02 }}; {{ insert: param, sr-11_odp.03 }} ].

controls.label: Anti-counterfeit Training
controls.description: Train [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles] to detect counterfeit system components (including hardware, software, and firmware).

controls.label: Configuration Control for Component Service and Repair
controls.description: Maintain configuration control over the following system components awaiting service or repair and serviced or repaired components awaiting return to service: [Assignment: organization-defined system components].

controls.label: Anti-counterfeit Scanning
controls.description: Scan for counterfeit system components [Assignment: organization-defined frequency].

controls.label: Component Disposal
controls.description: Dispose of [Assignment: organization-defined data, documentation, tools, or system components] using the following techniques and methods: [Assignment: organization-defined techniques and methods].
